(5 items) When you deal direct damage with a Blink, Charge, Leap, Teleport, or Pull ability, you consecrate the ground beneath you for |cffffff10|r seconds and gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff1595|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Every |cffffff2|r seconds you and nearby group members in the area gain Minor Courage for |cffffff12|r seconds. These effects can occur once every |cffffff20|r seconds and the damage shield scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
